text:
Alice: FYI - customer on Dedicated Private (VPC) reports intermittent 401s since yesterday after Istio upgrade. They say Authorization header present at LB but missing at backend. Repro steps attached.
Carlos: Can you paste the incoming request headers from the LB? Need raw capture (tcpdump/pcap) or Envoy access logs.
Alice: From customer tcpdump: client->LB: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
LB->envoy-sidecar: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Envoy sidecar->upstream: (no Authorization header)
Dana: This looks like ext_authz response header routing — if ext_authz returns 200 with 'x-forwarded-authorization' header we propagate; but Envoy may drop large header sets. Any cookie size? NLB is also adding 'set-cookie' fragments.
Emily: Security note: our ext_authz filter strips Authorization if authz-backend returns DENY and policy is strict. But here they see 200 from ext_authz. Could be header fragmentation from NLB chunking. Also check Istio proxy versions; we saw reordering when total header size > 8k.
Frank: Can you run this repro from inside a pod and capture envoy debug? Command:

kubectl exec -it svc/backend-0 -- bash -c "tcpdump -i any -w /tmp/capture.pcap port 443"

and curl repro:

curl -v -H 'Host: api.customer.internal' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' https://<vpc-lb-ip>/v1/models

Alice: Customer ran above. They attached envoy access logs snippet:
[envoy] "GET /v1/models" 401 - "Authorization" not present at upstream

Customer tcpdump shows Authorization present to LB, absent between LB->envoy sidecar.
Carlos: Can you dump the ext_authz response headers? Use: kubectl logs -c ext-authz -l app=authz --tail=200 | grep -A3 x-forwarded
Alice: Paste ext_authz response: 'x-forwarded-authorization: Bearer TOKEN' and 'x-auth-reason: ok'
Dana: Hmm. Then something between ext_authz and upstream is stripping normal Authorization and replacing it w/ x-forwarded-authorization, but our envoy filter only maps that header when include_request_headers_in_check is true. What's the EnvoyFilter config on their mesh? Can you share MeshConfig/EnvoyFilter?
Alice: Customer EnvoyFilter:

apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: EnvoyFilter
metadata:
  name: authz-propagate
spec:
  configPatches:
  - applyTo: HTTP_FILTER
    match: {context: SIDECAR_INBOUND}
    patch: { ... }

Carlos: That patch looks ok. Two theories: 1) envoys on that node have header size limit too low and chunking causes header to be dropped; 2) NLB/Proxy is doing header rewriting for oversized cookies.
Emily: We also saw a prior bug where x-forwarded-* headers are normalized and then the Authorization header removed to prevent duplicate creds. I've filed a quick security policy PR to allow propagate-authorization for trusted upstreams.
Frank: In the meantime can we workaround by adding an explicit envoy header_to_append config to copy x-forwarded-authorization -> Authorization at the sidecar? e.g. EnvoyFilter with header_manipulation to set request_headers_to_add.
Dana: Tested locally: adding patch fixes 401 in staging. Patch diff: (short snippet)

- name: envoy.filters.http.header_to_add
  config:
    request_headers_to_add:
      - header:
          key: Authorization
          value: "%REQ(X-FORWARDED-AUTHORIZATION)%"

Alice: Customer applied patch to a canary pod and reports 200s restored. Will open support ticket recommending patch + istio upgrade. Eng teams, can we schedule follow-up to root cause: header size / istio ext_authz behavior? @emily @carlos
Carlos: I'll put a tracking issue and link reproducer and pcap. Likely infra needs to increase proxy_buffer_size and validate NLB chunking behavior.
Emily: I'll review security policy change and ensure we only allow trusted upstreams.
Frank: I'll coordinate a staging rollout and add an alert if Authorization header missing at upstream for more than 5min.
deploy-bot: Rollout started: authz-propagate-fix -> staging
Alice: Closing loop with customer: they confirmed canary ok, will monitor. Will reopen if flaps. :thumbsup:
